_comment: Generated by the POKECHARGE asset pipeline. Do not hand-edit paths without re-running tools/generate_pokemon_index.py.

pokemon.name: Eevee
pokemon.description: Its genetic structure is unstable. Eevee waits patiently, ready to evolve the instant it finds purpose.

pokemon.name: Snorlax
pokemon.description: A famously sleepy Pokemon. It stirs only for food, or for a slow, contented charge.

pokemon.name: Charmander
pokemon.description: The flame on its tail shows its feelings. It burns brighter the more energy it receives.

pokemon.name: Arcanine
pokemon.description: A Pokemon admired for its beauty and speed, radiating steady heat as it charges.

pokemon.name: Squirtle
pokemon.description: After birth its back swells and hardens into a shell, calm and buoyant while it charges.

pokemon.name: Vaporeon
pokemon.description: Its cells resemble water molecules, letting it dissolve into any current of energy.

pokemon.name: Pikachu
pokemon.description: Its electric sacs build charge. It releases sparks when startled, delighted, or charging.

pokemon.name: Jolteon
pokemon.description: Stores a vast amount of negative ions in its fur, discharging crackling energy.

pokemon.name: Bulbasaur
pokemon.description: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. It grows alongside the bulb, soaking in energy.

pokemon.name: Leafeon
pokemon.description: Its body is always cool, filled with clean air through photosynthesis as it charges.

pokemon.name: Glaceon
pokemon.description: It can freeze the air around it, scattering crystals that form unique patterns while charging.

pokemon.name: Lapras
pokemon.description: A gentle Pokemon that glides calmly, humming softly as frost gathers along its shell.

pokemon.name: Lucario
pokemon.description: It reads auras to sense feelings and intentions, channelling focused energy as it charges.

pokemon.name: Machamp
pokemon.description: With four muscled arms, it can throw a flurry of punches in a controlled training rhythm.

pokemon.name: Gengar
pokemon.description: On the night of a full moon, it likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh quietly.

pokemon.name: Crobat
pokemon.description: Flies so silently through the night that it is dubbed the ninja of the skies.

pokemon.name: Sandshrew
pokemon.description: It burrows deep underground in arid locations, curling up as it stores energy.

pokemon.name: Garchomp
pokemon.description: Resembling a jet plane, it tucks its wings close as dust gathers along its scales.

pokemon.name: Pidgeot
pokemon.description: It flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey from a graceful soaring altitude.

pokemon.name: Noivern
pokemon.description: Called the Baron of the Night Sky, it navigates using sound waves from its large ears.

pokemon.name: Mewtwo
pokemon.description: Created by genetic manipulation, its psychic power is said to be the strongest of all.

pokemon.name: Alakazam
pokemon.description: Its brain continually grows, said to remember everything from the moment of birth.

pokemon.name: Butterfree
pokemon.description: In battle it flaps its wings to release highly toxic dust into the air.

pokemon.name: Scizor
pokemon.description: Its body is covered with a hard, metallic shell that it hones like a blade.

pokemon.name: Onix
pokemon.description: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden into something like a diamond.

pokemon.name: Tyranitar
pokemon.description: So powerful it can topple a mountain, yet it rests calmly while gathering energy.

pokemon.name: Misdreavus
pokemon.description: It enjoys tormenting people with a chilling cry, flickering at the edge of sight.

pokemon.name: Banette
pokemon.description: Born when a discarded doll gained a spirit, driven by a grudge it quietly channels.

pokemon.name: Dragonite
pokemon.description: An extremely rarely seen marine Pokemon, said to be able to circle the globe in days.

pokemon.name: Salamence
pokemon.description: Once it grows wings, it is said to have finally gained the ability to fly into the heavens.

pokemon.name: Umbreon
pokemon.description: When darkness falls, the rings on its body glow a sinister yellow-ring, red as it charges.

pokemon.name: Absol
pokemon.description: Sensing coming disasters, it appears before people - a quiet, watchful presence.

pokemon.name: Metagross
pokemon.description: Four brains linked together make it smarter than a supercomputer, humming with current.

pokemon.name: Aggron
pokemon.description: It constantly patrols its territory, its steel armor gleaming as it charges steadily.

pokemon.name: Sylveon
pokemon.description: It is able to emit a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm hostilities.

pokemon.name: Clefable
pokemon.description: A timid fairy Pokemon rarely seen, said to dance beneath the full moon.
